an3.124:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] yassaṃ bhikkhave, disāyaṃ bhikkhū bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti, manasi kātumpi me esā bhikkhave, disā na phāsu hoti. pageva gantuṃ.
an3.124:1.3: “addhā te āyasmanto tayo dhamme pajahiṃsu, tayo dhamme bahulamakaṃsu.”
an3.124:1.10: yassaṃ bhikkhave, disāyaṃ bhikkhū bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti, manasikātumpi me esā bhikkhave, disā na phāsu hoti. pageva gantuṃ.
an3.124:1.12: “addhā te āyasmanto ime tayo dhamme pajahiṃsu. ime tayo dhamme bahulamakaṃsu.”
an3.124:2.1: yassaṃ bhikkhave, disāyaṃ bhikkhū samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharanti, gantumpi me esā bhikkhave, disā phāsu hoti. pageva manasi kātuṃ.
an3.124:2.3: “addhā te āyasmanto tayo dhamme pajahiṃsu, tayo dhamme bahulamakaṃsu.”
an3.124:2.10: yassaṃ bhikkhave, disāyaṃ bhikkhū samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharanti, gantumpi me esā bhikkhave, disā phāsu hoti. pageva manasi kātuṃ.
an3.124:2.12: “addhā te āyasmanto ime tayo dhamme pajahiṃsu, ime tayo dhamme bahulamakaṃsū”ti.
